description.value: Climb Base5 is an indoor rock climbing gym serving Metro Vancouver with facilities in North Vancouver and Coquitlam, offering bouldering, auto-belays, top rope, and lead climbing for all skill levels. The gym emphasizes community, inclusivity, and progression through structured courses, youth programs, and adult training. A touring cyclist looking for an active rest day activity will find a well-equipped facility with beginner-friendly entry points including auto-belay orientations and introductory belay courses.
